# Evenium

Evenium is an all-in-one event management platform that simplifies the planning, execution, and analysis of professional events.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/evenium/.

## Actions

- **Get Contacts** (read-only): Retrieve a list of contacts from evenium.
- **Get Events** (read-only): Retrieve a list of events with optional filters.
- **Logout**: Log out the current user and invalidate the session token.
